name: Summer D.A.Y.S. (Daytime Activities and Youth Sports)
description_short: Belchertown's town day camp for children entering grades 1 to 7, in one week sessions. Campers play sports and games, make crafts, swim at the Chestnut Hill Community School pool three days a week, spend Tuesdays at the Town Beach and take a field trip each week.
refund_policy_summary: Full refund less a $10 fee if requested before the registration deadline, 10 days before the week starts.
swim_waterfront_notes: Swim test each Monday. Free swim Monday, Wednesday and Friday at the Chestnut Hill Community School pool; Tuesdays at the Town Beach. Swim lessons in weeks 4, 6 and 7 for $25 extra.
notes: Resident rate $155 a week ($124 for the short Week 2). Week 1 is at Chestnut Hill Community School; Weeks 2 to 7 at Belchertown High School. Swim lessons $25 extra in weeks 4, 6 and 7.

sources.note: Researched by Claude from this page. Summer 2026 parent packet. Boys and girls entering grades 1 to 7 (ages derived), 8:00 am to 4:00 pm, seven one week sessions June 22 to August 7 (Week 2 June 29 to July 2). Week 1 at Chestnut Hill School, Weeks 2 to 7 at Belchertown High School. $155 resident, $165 non resident a week; short Week 2 $124 resident, $134 non resident. Lunch provided on Tuesdays at the beach; otherwise bring lunch. Weekly field trip included in the fee.
